raw.description:
Job Purpose

The Account Executive will be responsible for managing day\-to\-day accounting activities, maintaining accurate financial records, handling billing and payments, and ensuring timely entries and reports in **Tally ERP / Tally Prime**.

Key Responsibilities

* Record daily accounting transactions in Tally, including sales, purchase, receipt, payment, journal, and contra entries.
* Prepare and maintain invoices, delivery challans, and payment vouchers.
* Handle accounts payable and accounts receivable activities.
* Follow up with customers for outstanding payments and maintain debtor ageing reports.
* Reconcile bank statements, customer accounts, supplier accounts, and cash records.
* Maintain petty cash records and process expense vouchers.
* Prepare GST\-related data, including sales register, purchase register, input tax credit details, and GST reconciliation.
* Maintain supporting documents, bills, invoices, and statutory records in an organized manner.
* Coordinate with auditors, vendors, customers, and internal departments for accounting\-related queries.
* Ensure compliance with company accounting policies and statutory requirements.
* Support payroll\-related entries, reimbursements, and employee expense claims, if required.
* Perform any other accounts and administrative work assigned by management.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in accounts and finance; freshers with strong Tally knowledge may also apply.
* Good working knowledge of **Tally Prime / Tally ERP**, MS Excel, Word, and email communication.
* Knowledge of GST, TDS, invoicing, bank reconciliation, and basic accounting principles.
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and ability to meet deadlines.
* Good communication and coordination skills.

Preferred

* Experience in manufacturing, trading, or service industry accounts.
* Knowledge of e\-invoicing, e\-way bills, and basic payroll accounting.

Pay: ₹22,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

About the Company

Blacksmith Woven Conversion is a growing organization committed to delivering quality products and exceptional customer service. We are looking for a detail\-oriented and organized Back Office Executive to support our day\-to\-day administrative, operational, and coordination activities.

Job Summary

The Back Office Executive will be responsible for managing administrative tasks, maintaining records, coordinating with internal departments, and ensuring smooth operational workflows. The ideal candidate should possess strong organizational skills, attention to detail, proficiency in computer applications, and the ability to handle multiple responsibilities efficiently.

Key ResponsibilitiesAdministrative Support

* Manage and maintain company records, documents, and files.
* Prepare, update, and organize reports, spreadsheets, and business documents.
* Perform data entry and maintain accurate records in ERP software and company databases.
* Ensure proper documentation and filing of invoices, purchase orders, sales orders, and other business records.

ERP \& Data Management

* Enter and update customer, vendor, and transaction data in the ERP system.
* Generate reports related to sales, inventory, dispatch, and operations.
* Verify data accuracy and resolve discrepancies when required.
* Assist departments in maintaining updated records and operational information.

Coordination \& Communication

* Coordinate with Sales, Production, Dispatch, Accounts, and Purchase departments for smooth workflow execution.
* Follow up on pending orders, dispatch schedules, and documentation requirements.
* Assist in handling customer inquiries and internal communication.
* Ensure timely sharing of information between departments.

Documentation \& Reporting

* Prepare quotations, delivery challans, invoices, and other operational documents.
* Generate daily, weekly, and monthly reports as required by management.
* Maintain records of orders, inventory movements, and customer communications.
* Support management with data collection and report preparation.

Office Operations

* Monitor office supplies and coordinate procurement requirements.
* Assist in maintaining office procedures and administrative systems.
* Handle routine correspondence through email and phone communication.
* Support management in various operational and administrative activities.

Required Skills \& Competencies

* Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint).
* Basic knowledge of ERP software and business processes.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team.
* Strong time\-management and problem\-solving skills.
* Professional attitude and willingness to learn.

Educational Qualification

* Graduate in B.Com, BBA, BA, BCA, or any relevant discipline.
* Additional certification in Computer Applications or ERP software will be an advantage.

Experience Requirements

* 1–3 years of experience in Back Office Operations, Administration, Data Management, or Coordination roles.
* Freshers with strong computer skills and willingness to learn may also apply.
* Experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment will be preferred.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Accuracy of data entry and documentation.
* Timely completion of assigned tasks and reports.
* Effective coordination with internal departments.
* Maintenance of organized records and files.
* ERP data accuracy and system updates.
* Overall administrative efficiency and support.

Pay: ₹18,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Life insurance

Work Location: In person

description: Cash Custodian is responsible for the safe handling, recording, and reconciliation of cash and other cash\-equivalent items within an organization (such as a bank, retail store, hotel, hospital, or corporate office). Key Responsibilities of a Cash Custodian Receive and safeguard cash, cheques, and other negotiable instruments. Count and verify cash at the beginning and end of each shift. Maintain accurate records of all cash receipts and payments. Prepare and reconcile daily cash reports with system records. Ensure all cash transactions comply with company policies and internal controls. Deposit cash into the bank or arrange secure cash collection. Maintain petty cash and process reimbursements where applicable. Investigate and report any cash shortages, overages, or discrepancies immediately. Keep cash vaults, safes, and cash drawers secure at all times. Assist during internal and external audits by providing required documentation. Coordinate with finance, operations, or bank personnel regarding cash\-related issues. Ensure confidentiality and security of financial information. Skills Required Strong numerical and cash\-handling skills. Attention to detail and accuracy. Integrity and honesty. Knowledge of basic accounting and reconciliation. Ability to use cash management systems and Microsoft Excel. Good communication and organizational skills. These responsibilities may vary slightly depending on the industry and employer, but the core duty is to ensure that all cash is handled securely, accurately, and in compliance with organizational procedures. Pay: ₹9,399\.82 \- ₹12,000\.00 per month Benefits: * Provident Fund Work Location: On the road

The Customer Relationship Executive (CRE) is the first point of contact for customers visiting the Apple Authorized Service Center. The role focuses on delivering excellent customer service, handling service requests, coordinating repairs, and ensuring a smooth end\-to\-end customer experience in line with Apple service standards.

**Key ResponsibilitiesCustomer Handling**

* Greet customers and understand issues related to Apple devices (iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, etc.).
* Create service jobs by accurately capturing customer details and device information.
* Explain warranty status, service procedures, repair timelines, and applicable charges.

**Service Coordination**

* Coordinate with technicians to track diagnosis and repair progress.
* Update customers regularly on repair status (in\-progress, parts awaited, ready for pickup).
* Ensure proper documentation for device intake and delivery.

**Billing \& Documentation**

* Generate estimates, invoices, and collect payments as per process.
* Handle buyback, replacements, DOA cases, and escalations as required.
* Maintain accurate records in Apple systems and internal trackers.

**Quality \& Compliance**

* Follow Apple Authorized Service Provider (AASP) guidelines and SOPs.
* Ensure data privacy, device safety, and customer consent procedures.
* Support audits, reports, and compliance requirements.

**Customer Experience**

* Resolve customer concerns professionally and escalate when required.
* Encourage customer feedback and Google reviews in a compliant manner.
* Maintain high CSAT and service quality standards.

**Skills \& Requirements**

* Graduate or equivalent (preferred).
* 1–3 years of experience in customer service / retail / service center roles.
* Good communication skills (English \+ local language).
* Basic computer knowledge and ability to work on service management systems.
* Customer\-centric attitude with problem\-solving skills.

**About Everly White**

Everly White is a creative arts studio rooted in artistry and awareness. We create handcrafted décor and lifestyle objects that honor the unseen and invite people to live more intentionally. Our work lives at the intersection of design, emotion, and energy, igniting a revolution in how luxury is felt and experienced.

We’re expanding our creative family and looking for a **Graphic Designer/ Video Editor** who can visually translate our essence of minimal, mystical, and meaningful — into compelling short\-form video/stories for social media.

**Role Overview**

You’ll be responsible for **conceptualizing, shooting, and editing Reels/carousals/posts** that bring Everly White’s products, philosophy, and stories to life. This is not just about trending content, but rather about creating emotion. We want someone who feels rhythm, aesthetics, and narrative intuitively.

**We’re seeking a creative professional who can:**

* Design visually striking and meaningful brand assets
* Create engaging social media creatives
* Edit high\-quality videos for reels, campaigns, and brand storytelling
* Use AI tools strategically to enhance workflow and concept development
* Maintain strong visual consistency across platforms

We want someone who understands *why* a design works.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design posters, banners, and marketing creatives
* Develop high\-impact social media posts
* Edit reels, promotional videos, and campaign content
* Perform photo editing and manipulation
* Apply strong typography, layout, and composition principles
* Use AI tools for brainstorming, mockups, and creative enhancement
* Collaborate with the team to translate ideas into compelling visuals
* Understanding of Instagram’s algorithm and what drives engagement.
* Located in or willing to relocate to **Guwahati**. (mandatory)

**Required Skills**

* Adobe Photoshop
* Adobe Illustrator
* Canva
* Strong typography and layout understanding
* Social Media \& Brand Design
* Photo Editing \& Manipulation
* Creative Concept Development

**Bonus Skills (Preferred):**

* Experience with AI design tools: Midjourney, Firefly, ChatGPT
* Video editing software (Premiere Pro / After Effects / CapCut or similar)
* Motion graphics basics

**Experience**

* 0–2 years of relevant experience
* A strong portfolio showcasing branding, social creatives, and video editing work

**What We’re Looking For**

* A self\-driven creative thinker
* Someone who meets deadlines without compromising quality
* Strong visual sense and attention to detail
* Passion for both static and motion design

**Personality Fit**

* You’re visually sensitive, emotionally intelligent, and creatively curious.
* You see content not as “marketing” but as an art form.
* You find meaning in life through romanticism and beauty.
* You have a natural feel for rhythm, aesthetics, and subtle storytelling.

**Pay**

12k \- 20k per month (depending on skillset)

**To Apply**

* Send your résumé, portfolio and/or Instagram handle, with a short note on *why and how do you resonate with Everly White’s philosophy* to **everlywhiteshop@gmail.com**.

We are seeking a motivated Social Media Specialist to effectively engage with targeted virtual communities and network users.

Our objective is to achieve exceptional customer engagement, foster intimacy, drive website traffic, and increase revenue through strategic utilization of the social media marketing roadmap.

The ideal candidate should possess a comprehensive understanding of various social media platforms and how to optimize content for maximum engagement.

As a representative of our brand, you will actively participate in relevant conversations, gently promoting our products/services while providing support to existing and potential customers.

* Create editorial calendars and syndication schedules
* Continuously improve by capturing and analyzing the appropriate social data/metrics, insights and best practices, and then acting on the information
* Collaborate with other departments (customer relations, sales etc) to manage reputation, identify key players and coordinate actions

**Requirements and skills**

* Proven working experience in social media marketing or as a Digital Media Specialist
* Excellent consulting, writing, editing (photo/video/text), presentation and communication skills
* Demonstrable social networking experience and social analytics tools knowledge
* Adequate knowledge of web design, web development, CRO and SEO
* Knowledge of online marketing and good understanding of major marketing channels
* Positive attitude, detail and customer oriented with good multitasking and organisational ability

raw.title: Travel Content Intern
raw.description:
About the Role



We are looking for a passionate and creative travel enthusiast to manage our travel portal blogs, destination content, and travel deal promotions across digital platforms. The ideal candidate loves storytelling, stays updated on travel trends, and can create engaging content that inspires travelers while driving traffic and conversions.

  

* Candidates pursuing the final year of a Travel \& Tourism Management course are strongly encouraged to apply
* Freshers with strong writing and research skills may also apply
* Prior blogging or social media experience will be an added advantage

  



Key Responsibilities


* Research and write engaging travel blogs, destination guides, itineraries, and travel tips.
* Upload and manage travel content on websites, blogs, and CMS platforms.
* Curate and publish travel deals, vacation packages, flight offers, and hotel promotions.
* Optimize content for SEO using keywords, meta descriptions, and internal linking.
* Manage social media posts related to travel offers and blog promotions.
* Coordinate with marketing, design, and sales teams for campaigns and promotions.
* Monitor website traffic, content performance, and engagement metrics.
* Ensure content accuracy, originality, and alignment with brand voice.
* Stay updated on travel industry trends, tourism news, and competitor activities.

  



Requirements


* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Passion for travel, tourism, and digital storytelling.
* Basic understanding of SEO and content marketing.
* Familiarity with WordPress, Canva, Google Docs, or similar tools.
* Ability to research destinations, travel trends, and online deals.
* Social media management skills are a plus.
* Photography, video editing, or graphic design knowledge is an advantage.
* Internship candidates: pursuing or recently completed a degree in Marketing, Journalism, Tourism, Hospitality, or related field.

  



Preferred Skills


* Blog writing and copywriting
* SEO optimization
* Social media marketing
* Content scheduling and publishing
* Email marketing
* Affiliate marketing knowledge
* Basic analytics understanding (Google Analytics/Search Console)

  



What We Offer


* Opportunity to work in the travel and tourism industry
* Flexible work environment
* Hands\-on digital marketing experience
* Exposure to travel partnerships and campaigns
* Career growth opportunities

  



How to Apply



Send your resume, writing samples, blog portfolio, or social media handles showcasing your travel content work.

  

* Resume / portfolio
* 2–3 travel writing samples
* Links to blogs, social media pages, or published work
* Expected freelance rates
